reddit.title: Improving Flowing Water Performance in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant optimizations to how flowing lakes are handled in Provincia. Previously, drying one cell would require rescanning the entire map, leading to performance issues. Now, we've reduced the script time for a 64×64 flowing lake from 20 ms to just 12 ms. This means smoother gameplay and a better experience for you! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

posts: Exciting news! We've optimized the performance of flowing lakes in Provincia. Now, when a cell dries, only that chunk and its neighbors are affected, significantly reducing script time. Learn more about the improvements here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

steam.title: Performance Improvements for Flowing Water
steam.body: We're excited to announce that we've made optimizations to how flowing lakes operate in Provincia. By reducing the script time when drying cells, we've enhanced the overall performance of the game. This means a smoother experience for players as we continue to refine the game's mechanics. For more details, check out our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
